events.name: Apley Farm Shop Nature Trail
events.description: Ongoing family nature trail at Apley Farm Shop. Families follow the missing-magic-seeds story using a workbook or trail app, with wildlife facts, wood carvings and hands-on activities. Visit Telford lists the trail daily through 31 December 2026.

events.name: Ludlow Library Lego Club – 14 September
events.description: Free term-time Monday Lego Club at Ludlow Library. Children of all ages are welcome, from Duplo beginners to experienced builders.
events.accessibility: Ludlow Library lists disabled access, disabled parking, disabled toilets, level entry access and a lift.

events.description: Term-time PODS sensory session in a dedicated sensory room with lights, bubble tube and ball pit. Parents remain on site; adults do not require a ticket and a ticket should be booked for each child.

events.description: Free board-gaming session at Oswestry Library on the third Saturday of the month. No booking is required.

events.name: Free 0–5 Parenting Group – The Lantern – 21 September
events.description: Free weekly parenting support group for parent carers of children aged 0–5, covering communication and connection, routines, behaviour and emotions, transitions and child development. This record represents the first confirmed session only because the council source contains an impossible series end date.

events.name: Sounds in the Square – Wellington – 26 September
events.description: Free live music in Wellington Market Square. The 26 September session is explicitly listed by Wellington Town Council and features Funky Town.

events.name: 1940s Living History Weekend – Whittington Castle
events.description: 1940s living-history weekend with authentic displays, historic vehicles and re-enactors at Whittington Castle. The organiser describes it as suitable for the whole family.

events.name: Wildlife Poetry Walk & Talk – Cuan Wildlife Rescue
events.description: Wildlife and poetry walk at Eaton Manor followed by an indoor talk from Cuan Wildlife Rescue founder Megan Morris-Jones, with tea, coffee and cake. The walk is on uneven ground and can be shortened if preferred. Dogs are not permitted.
events.accessibility: The organiser asks visitors with accessibility requirements to contact them in advance; the walking route is over uneven ground.
events.parking_transport: Free parking is available on site.

events.name: Oswestry Makers Market – 24 October
events.description: The Makers Market in Oswestry with artisan food, crafts and independent makers. The primary organiser page confirms 24 October 2026, 10am–4pm, with free entry.

events.name: Wrekin Forest School Halloween & Bonfire Night Extravaganza
events.description: Family Halloween and Bonfire Night event with forest-school activities, pumpkin carving, food, bonfire traditions and fireworks. The organiser lists tickets from £3 to £35.

events.name: Halloween at Telford Ice Rink
events.description: Halloween disco at Telford Ice Rink with themed music, decorations and Halloween surprises on the ice.

events.name: Bonfire & Fireworks Night – Weston Park
events.description: Weston Park Bonfire & Fireworks Night with a bonfire, funfair, street food and two fireworks displays. Gates open at 3pm, bonfire is lit at 5pm, fireworks are at 6pm and 7:30pm, and the event closes at 9pm. Tickets must be bought in advance. Lowest paid early-bird ticket is £7 for children aged 4–14; under-4s are free.
events.accessibility: Accessible parking is available for Blue Badge holders and accessible toilets are provided.
events.parking_transport: Access is by car only; pedestrian admission is not permitted. Parking is on grass car parks and visitors must add a free car pass when booking. The car park is approximately a 10–15 minute walk from the event area.

events.name: Santa & Mrs Claus: Festive Fun at Hoo Zoo
events.description: Festive Hoo Zoo event with Christmas craft, Winter Wonderland, a meeting with Santa, a small gift, and a Mrs Claus/Head Elf singalong and storytime. Full zoo admission is included. Quiet sessions are offered on Wednesdays and Thursdays with reduced noise and no singalong.
events.source_name: Hoo Zoo and Dinosaur World / Visit Telford
